title: SubscriptionHeadView
description: The head line's `data`: the subscription the server established.

backlog.description:
**Revision 7, not emitted yet** (D6): how many backlog event lines follow the head
before live events, exactly. Omitted until emitted, and with a snapshot.

cursor.description:
The server's head boundary: the snapshot's boundary with a snapshot; without one,
the boundary after the backlog that follows (not the client's cursor).

resync_reason.description:
**Revision 7, not emitted yet** (D6): why the subscription started from a whole
snapshot although the client sent a cursor. Omitted until emitted, and without
such a restart.

snapshot.description:
The whole snapshot the subscription starts from: present when the client sent no
cursor or the server resnapshotted it. Omitted when resuming from the client's
cursor (today: `null`). Its `data` is today's untyped snapshot document; PC1 types
it (`crate::event::EventSnapshot`).

Cursor.description: Opaque, reader-scoped resumption token. Never parse it outside the runtime.

ResyncReason.description:
⟨rev7⟩ Why a subscription started from a whole snapshot, or why a stream or a page ended
(ADR-0013 §5.3, §5.4). Every gap ends the stream.

oneOf.description: Retention removed events the reader had not received.
An event does not fit one frame.
The missed backlog is longer than [`BACKLOG_MAX`] visible events.

The cursor is beyond the head, malformed, of an unknown version, or another reader's
or environment's.

Snapshot.description: A snapshot with the cursor boundary it is consistent with (spec §11.5).

cursor.description: Events after this cursor are not reflected in `data`.
